title: Signal front-end audit: F0, segmentation, envelope, pitch interpolation, pairing alignment
hypothesis: Seven suspected defect classes in the signal front-end produce measurable, silent errors: (1) FormantProxySynth envelope fails for voiced regions shorter than 2x30 ms; (2) autocorrelation F0 misreports 65-100 Hz as ~900 Hz; (3) F0 voicing gate is absolute, so any low-level periodic residue counts as voiced; (4) energy segmentation shifts onsets by -30 ms and inflates durations by +40 ms; (5) PitchCurve interpolates f0 linearly in Hz, up to +386 cents away from the perceptual midpoint; (6) per-syllable peak normalisation erases the loudness contour, which VHE cannot recover; (7) pairing overwrites the composite request fingerprint with the last syllable's fingerprint.
notes: Probe script was written before this record existed; see errata.

runs.purpose: same probes on the tree carrying the fixes for hypotheses 1-7
